newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex suspended on Amsterdam exchange.
newsitem.headline: Vendex suspended on Amsterdam exchange.

text.p: Trading in shares of retail and business services group Vendex International NV was suspended before opening on Monday until further notice, the Amsterdam Stock Exchange said.

Vendex had been tipped by analysts as a possible bidder for French temporary employment agency Bis, which ranks third in France in market share behind Adecco and Manpower and has 4,800 employees and a network of 500 agencies.
Shares in Bis were suspended on Monday last week at 533 francs after the death of chairman Laurent Negro who founded the firm and held some 60 percent of it, together with his family.

Vendex shares performed strongly last week as talk of a bid circulated in the Amsterdam market. Vendex gained 1.20 guilders, or 1.62 percent, on Thursday and a further 1.70 guilders, or 2.26 percent, on Friday to close at 76.80 guilders.

In July 1995, Vendex acquired French BIS Proprete, a professional cleaning unit with an annual turnover of some 565 million French francs, from Bis. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
